notice: Review/import material only. Not a platform API request, publication approval or completion claim.
objective: Publish a useful bounded numerical 0.1 with complete reproducible evidence and a verified native public Tanduna programme; preserve the wider scientific roadmap.
limits: No autonomous-scientist, optimizer novelty, generality or autoresearch-superiority claim from 0.1.
No new dependencies, cloud spend, untrusted execution, external outreach or publication without exact authority.
Later and exploratory outcomes are conditional on their evidence, resource and owner decisions, not promised release dates.

planningDecisions.decision: 228 outcomes across 28 waves are justified by source features and evidence obligations; future details are revised at wave entry, not promised as implementation subtasks or dates.
planningDecisions.evidence: Wave sizes vary from 7 to 12 new outcomes. Source mappings retain all 27 historical task identities.

planningDecisions.decision: Per-task progress is recorded only in plan/tasks.json; generated views and export are projections, while STATUS.md is the narrative and evidence summary.
